name.zh: 受 Isastraea 启发的低块多边星隔杯珊瑚

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish massive low colony with adjoining large polygonal star-septate cups in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以低块状群体由相接大多边星隔杯组成搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

sources.title: Scleractinia
sources.supports: Solitary cups and colonial scleractinian growth forms; does not verify all proposed genera.
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original shared-wall polygonal cups and radial septal relief. Stable inventory spelling isastraea retained; sources also use Isastrea. Nominal scale, cup/septum counts, palette and simplified relief are artistic; not a strict species/specimen reconstruction.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创相接多边杯与星隔浮雕。保留原清单稳定ID isastraea，来源亦使用 Isastrea 拼写。名义尺度、杯与隔壁数量、配色和简化起伏为美术选择，非严格物种或标本复原。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
